title: Fix Interactive Disposition Resize
description: The arc command doesn't preview correctly (no curve rendering for arc/circle-outline preview kinds) and produces wrong output (kernel reads radiusPoint instead of start)
summary: Lasso partial/full enclosure now uses the first horizontal mouse step (left = partial/crossing, right = full/enclosing) instead of the last pointer position. Rectangle selection still compares drag start vs end. Canonical logic lives in `@ui/react` (`marqueeCoverageFromGesture`, `marqueeIsCrossingFromPath`) and `mathematical_graph` (`selection_drag_enclosing`). Updated procedural, CAD, puzzle 3d, puzzle 2d (Rust/wasm), flow (board_host), and board engine overlay preview. Added Rust and puzzle 3d unit tests.
